channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: 14 killed in South Sudan plane crash near capital Juba
item.description: A passenger plane crashed southwest of South Sudan’s capital Juba, killing all 14 people on board.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump reviews peace plan; UN calls for Hormuz to reopen
item.description: UN chief says US-Iran standoff in the Strait of Hormuz risks triggering a global food emergency.

item.title: Bahrain strips 69 people of citizenship over Iran support
item.description: Rights groups have described the move as a 'blatant abuse of power'.

item.title: Who holds the cards in Iran-US talks?
item.description: Both the US and Iran claim to have the upper hand in negotiations over the war, but who holds the cards?

item.title: Iran FM in Russia says US has offered new round of talks
item.description: Russia is hosting Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in St. Petersburg for talks on a possible new round of talks.

item.title: King Charles and Queen Camilla arrive for high-profile US state visit
item.description: The British monarch’s US visit underscores shared history amid strained ties and tensions over the Iran conflict.

item.title: Hezbollah and Israel swap threats and strikes across Lebanon’s border
item.description: Iran-linked group reiterates defiance; Israeli defence minister threatens to ‘burn all of Lebanon'.

item.title: Iraqi president names Shia bloc candidate Ali al-Zaidi as PM-designate
item.description: Choice of al-Zaidi breaks a months-long deadlock after Trump opposed appointment of pro-Iran former PM al-Maliki.

item.title: Pakistan accused of attacking Afghan university
item.description: Air attacks on the province of Kunar have killed at least seven people and injured 75, sources tell the BBC.

item.title: Colombia offers record $1.4m-reward for rebel it blames for deadly bomb attack
item.description: Officials say a rebel leader known as "Marlon" ordered the attack in which 20 people were killed.
